The language beside Record and the transcript line in the player

acs.text: WHEN a recording has been processed and a Sofer.ai key is set THE SYSTEM SHALL send its audio to Sofer.ai, poll until the transcript is done, and keep its words with their times beside the asset; the asset's state SHALL say the transcript is `ready` and the manifest SHALL name it

WHEN anyone with the link asks for a ready shiur's transcript (`GET /api/v1/assets/{id}/transcript`) or its audio (`GET /api/v1/assets/{id}/audio`) THE SYSTEM SHALL answer without a sign-in, the audio by byte range too; before the transcript is ready the transcript read SHALL answer 404 `recording.no_transcript`

WHEN the leader turns recording on THE SYSTEM SHALL offer the transcript's language beside Record (English, Hebrew, Yiddish, French; English by default, with Hebrew words in Hebrew letters), remember the choice in the browser, and ask Sofer.ai for that language
WHILE no Sofer.ai key is set THE SYSTEM SHALL mark a processed recording's transcript `unavailable`, send nothing, and play the shiur as before

WHEN Sofer.ai answers that a transcript failed or was cancelled, or a submission fails three times, or it is not done after 6 hours, THE SYSTEM SHALL mark the transcript `failed` and leave the asset, its media and its manifest's playback as they were
WHILE a shiur with a ready transcript plays THE SYSTEM SHALL show the line being said under the player bar with the word being said marked, and a Transcript button SHALL hide and show it
